verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents operating Recruitee through natural-language commands, such as a chat assistant or conversational command interface. The only related items are a bare 'AI & Automation' feature heading, which does not describe natural-language operation, and an llms.txt docs index, which makes the documentation readable by machines but does not let users run the product. Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a SaaS applicant-tracking system, so the lack of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
